result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation appears to highlight Profile while the content is the Home feed, creating a clear state mismatch. A few horizontally scrolling items are clipped at the right edge, which is somewhat expected but looks untidy.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as the active/selected tab while the main content is clearly the Home discovery feed.
issues.suggestion: Sync the selected tab state with the visible route; highlight Home instead of Profile on this screen.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip is only a tiny sliver at the screen edge, making the filter row look accidentally cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or show a clearer partial next chip so the row reads as scrollable.

issues.description: In Fastest near you, the third restaurant name is abruptly truncated as “Trattoria Piccol” at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis with enough card peek width, or reduce card width slightly so clipped titles still look deliberate.
